text:
maria-finance: FYI — NexusHealth onboarding (Private VPC). They want us to pass through GCP GPU + network egress as line items on their invoice and switch our Private license to a consumption-style charge. Is that something we can offer or are there reseller/partner constraints?

sam-infra: Short answer: possible but messy. Two paths: 1) act as a reseller/partner and literally forward provider charges, or 2) bill the customer our consolidated committed spend + a Redwood margin. Both have legal/tax implications. Need to check partner agreements for GCP/AWS and marketplace rules. :thinking:

jenna-cs: Nexus insists on per-minute GPU usage visibility — procurement won't sign a flat annual license. They asked for per-GPU, per-region line items.

ravi-sales: From sales POV we can map this to the Dedicated reserved model (monthly commit, billed as usage), but Private/VPC is tricky because the infra sits in their VPC. If they want pass-through, do they expect us to pull raw cloud invoices from their billing account? That could be a security/data-sharing issue.

billing-bot: Note: reseller policy doc (internal): https://internal.docs/reseller-policy — resale of raw provider invoices requires partner status and approved resale margin caps. Also triggers alternate tax handling.

alex-legal: If we resell provider costs we need partner contracts and indemnities. Also VAT/tax registration may be required in customer region if we appear as the supplier of cloud services. Recommend involving Partnerships and Tax/Finance.

sam-infra: Practical metering question: can infra instrument per-tenant GPU seconds for Private installs? Yes, but we need to ensure metering hooks are enabled and signed off. We also need a way to correlate customer VPC usage to provider invoice lines if they insist on exact pass-through. Sample invoice breakdown the customer requested:```
GPU usage (a100): $12,340.12
Network egress (US->EU): $432.00
Persistent disk IO: $23.45
KMS: $25.00
Redwood service margin (proposed): $1,234.01
Total pass-through: $14,054.58
```

maria-finance: OK — proposed action items: 1) Sales (ravi) to confirm with Nexus whether they accept reseller terms or require raw invoice forwarding. 2) Legal (alex) + Partnerships to validate reseller route and draft partner addendum. 3) Finance to model revenue recognition and tax impact for both reseller vs. consolidated billing. 4) Infra (sam) to detail metering feasibility and endpoints for per-tenant usage. Can we have owners by EOW?

jenna-cs: CC @alex-legal — Customer deadline EOW, they want a proposal by Friday.

ravi-sales: I'll own sales/partner outreach. Linking reseller checklist: https://internal.docs/reseller-checklist — will update by Thursday.

maria-finance: Thanks all :thumbsup: — I'll open a formal billing ticket and attach Nexus' procurement note. Will escalate if any blocker on partner signoff.
